objective: The Actions budget guard in scripts/runner/actions-budget.mjs fails open: when billing usage cannot be read the run proceeds. Make an unknown budget block by default, with ATLAS_ACTIONS_UNKNOWN_POLICY=allow as the explicit opt-out and any other value blocking. Export budgetVerdict(usage, environment) and runBudgetCheck(environment, read) as the tests in scripts/runner/actions-budget.test.mjs describe; negative or non-finite usage counts as unknown, and error text from the billing call must not be echoed. When ATLAS_OUTPUT_DIR is set the check writes budget.json (the verdict) and, when blocking, status.json with status 'blocked'; renderResult and renderRunSummary accept the budget and show a line 'Actions budget: <DECISION> — <action>. <reason>' (see the tests).
